gen-gf-grandstander-gf-michroma: Grandstander speaks up with constant-width lines, short ascenders and a tall x-height. Michroma, a plain sans, gives each letter a wide berth and leaves its curves open for quiet reading.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One has a very large lowercase and one stroke width. Grandstander is the loud one, bold with short ascenders, while Mochiy Pop One hangs its letters like clothespins on a line.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Mochiy Pop P One leaves wide gaps between its letters. Over a full page, the sizable lowercase of Mochiy Pop P One keeps its stroke uniform, with none of a brush's swell, while Grandstander stays bold above.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-montserrat-underl: Montserrat Underline has oversized lowercase and round bowls with unswelling walls. Montserrat Underline reads smoothly line after line, its counters breathing, while Grandstander up top stays bold and expressive.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-mozilla-headline: Bold, expressive lines meet big-bodied lowercase. Grandstander keeps its heading lines constant in width, while Mozilla Headline, a sans, flicks out a splayed c terminal on its big letters.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-mozilla-text: Grandstander draws bold, expressive letters from constant-width lines, like a bent steel rod, with short ascenders and a tall x-height. Mozilla Text, a sans, flares its terminals and looks sturdy in lowercase.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-nata-sans: Grandstander draws bold, expressive letters with constant-width lines and short ascenders. Nata Sans, a plain sans, adds wide, unclosed curves and a technical-pen steadiness, and that mix of loud and measured is what sticks.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-nobile: Grandstander draws bold letters like bent wire, tall in x-height. Nobile, a sans, brings open letter mouths and almost no gap between lowercase and capitals, so it reads tidily and modern.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Grandstander draws bold, expressive letters in hairline-free, shadow-free strokes, with short ascenders. Noto Kufi Arabic, a sans-serif, stays modern and clean, with an open c and capitals only slightly above lowercase.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans: Bold lines with short ascenders and a tall x-height give Grandstander its push. And Noto Sans, a sans with a generous c, lowercase filling most of the letter height, is the quiet counterweight that makes it work.
